title: Under Desk Cable Management Tray Cord Holder Storage Office Home Table Tidy Rack
body_html:
Description
Top-Cable Management Under Desk, Under Desk Cable Management Tray, Desk Cable Organizer,Cable Management Box,Cord Organizer


Collect cables and lines together. It makes your work area easier to keep tidy. Mesh grid design, with good load-bearing capacity, can hold more wires. Owning good workmanship and delicate details, suitable for home, office, etc.

Features
-Colour:Black
-Material:Iron
-Size:39*12*7cm/15.33*4.72*2.76in
-Great for storing most of the cables, such as wire, socket, charger wire, keyboard wire, that is widely in use.
-The Cable Management Tray allows the wires under the desktop to be neatly arranged and easy to take, bring a wonderful experience.
-Can collect your cables and wires together easily, create a tidy room, bring a larger space for your desk or room.
-Very practical, compact size and light weight, saving space, install under the desk, even a girl can install it.
-The design of the rack is firm, it has a good load-bearing capacity, and is not easy to fall off.
Package includes
1 x Cable Manager Rack
